name: Manasawa Sena
source:
The mother of the main character's fiancé. She is good-natured and nosy. She is devoted to her household chores and work. 

She is often called the "reincarnation of the virgin mother" by others for always lending a hand to even the most difficult of people.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt277/apt277.html#link_character] official site[/url]]
